title: How to Use ChatGPT for Interview Prep | 5 Prompts to Nail Your Next Interview
description:
Did you know you can use ChatGPT for interview prep? 

Interviews are nerve-wracking no matter what—but using AI tools like ChatGPT or Bard as a coach ahead of time can do wonders to build your confidence and help you feel more prepared. 

00:00 Introduction
00:12 Get common questions that might be asked
01:16 Get example answers to potential questions
02:16 Have ChatGPT give feedback on your answers
03:15 Get interview tips
03:49 Save all of your interview prep in Teal
04:02 Follow up with a hiring manager after an interview
04:47 Wrap-up & conclusion

More ChatGPT prompts to help with interview prep: https://www.tealhq.com/post/how-to-use-chatgpt-to-prepare-for-a-job-interview
